cpu_active_only.semantics: 1 Hz interval statistics, not instantaneous peaks or repeat confidence intervals. Intervals outside 0.5–2.5 s are excluded from peaks/near-95% durations. 95% is a descriptive warning threshold, not proof of CPU saturation. Process CPU sums all threads; tick-thread CPU was not collected separately. Per-core CPU includes all processes on that core; the tick thread may migrate. Executing CPU excludes idle/iowait/steal; steal is reported separately.

limits.world_seed: Entropy-seeded World; bot seed 30 does not fix entity trajectories.
limits.instrumentation_difference: 994cce8 includes actual-encoder ConnectAuth character_id/name offset fix from 227a9ec and parser-equivalent Clippy cleanup. Mapping only; unchanged sequence/retry/input/ACK/fingerprint semantics relative to 30ec792. Live controller map polling also has measured SSH wall cost, not isolated causal slowdown.
limits.sequence_assumptions: No unseen data-command advance >=32768 and no port reuse; compact capture cannot prove these. ACKs do not advance history. Half-range observations remain unclassified.
limits.wire_semantics: Interface capture precedes socket drops. Identity-aligned wire counts are not application-delivered inputs; cross-host UTC-second count mismatches are not loss estimates.
limits.read_gap_semantics: Time between receive attempts, including sleep; not queue residence.
limits.delivery_age_semantics: Application-observed time since last message; not one-way latency or queue residence.
limits.capture_eof_semantics: Game capture stops before swarm termination during cleanup; filter-received minus captured records unconsumed capture-tail accounting, not zero total capture loss. EOF is pipe completion, checked separately against packet counts, timestamps, malformed packets and capture loss. Zero malformed packets is not zero application loss.
limits.bin_semantics: Duplicate timestamps merged. Empty 10ms bins are absent; distributions condition on traffic bins. Active mapped input port-seconds explicitly include zeros.
